THE ELECTRICAL AGE. OCTOBER, 1949
FINNISH REFLECTIONS
By CAROLINE HASLETT
I FLEW into Finland soon after the Armistice in 1945, and was impressed, as I had been before the war, by the austere charm of the country, and now even more by the hospitality and indomitable spirit of the people in the midst of much bleakness. In June, 1949, I flew again to Finland to attend a meeting of the Board of Directors of the International Federation of Business and Professional Women, and could assess in some measure the progress made in face of heavy odds.

brief_context: Finland's first female Cabinet Minister mentioned in the text.
brief_extract:
